keys: Adds an old television screen look.
en: Adds an old television screen look.
zh: 启用老式电视屏幕画面效果。

keys: Connects to a dedicated server running on this machine (127.0.0.1) instead of the public server.
en: Connects to a dedicated server running on this machine (127.0.0.1) instead of the public server.
zh: 连接到本机专用服务器（127.0.0.1）而非公共服务器。

keys: Makes the game fill your whole screen.
en: Makes the game fill your whole screen.

keys: Resets all game windows to their default size and position.
en: Resets all game windows to their default size and position.
zh: 将所有游戏窗口恢复为默认大小与位置。

keys: Sends anonymous crash and error reports to help fix bugs. No personal data is collected.
en: Sends anonymous crash and error reports to help fix bugs. No personal data is collected.
zh: 发送匿名崩溃与错误报告以帮助修复问题，不会收集任何个人数据。

keys: Sets the size of the game window.
en: Sets the size of the game window.

keys: Sets the volume of alerts meant for you: whispers, level ups, skill ups and quest updates.
en: Sets the volume of alerts meant for you: whispers, level ups, skill ups and quest updates.
zh: 设置专属提示音量：私聊、升级、技能提升与任务更新。

keys: Sets the volume of combat feedback like hits, crits, dodges and heals.
en: Sets the volume of combat feedback like hits, crits, dodges and heals.
zh: 设置战斗反馈音量：命中、暴击、闪避与治疗。

keys: Sets the volume of creatures and surrounding objects: attacks, deaths and chests opening.
en: Sets the volume of creatures and surrounding objects: attacks, deaths and chests opening.
zh: 设置生物与环境音量：攻击、死亡与开箱。

keys: Sets the volume of every sound in the game at once.
en: Sets the volume of every sound in the game at once.
zh: 一次性设置游戏中所有声音的音量。

keys: Sets the volume of fights you are not part of. Your own actions and your target stay at full volume.
en: Sets the volume of fights you are not part of. Your own actions and your target stay at full volume.
zh: 设置非本人战斗的音量。你自己的动作与目标始终保持全音量。

keys: Sets the volume of the background music.
en: Sets the volume of the background music.

keys: Shows touch buttons on screen for movement and actions.
en: Shows touch buttons on screen for movement and actions.
zh: 在屏幕上显示移动与操作的触屏按钮。

keys: Silences the game while its window is in the background.
en: Silences the game while its window is in the background.
zh: 游戏窗口在后台时静音。

keys: Smooths the image when the view is scaled up.
en: Smooths the image when the view is scaled up.

keys: Turns on dynamic lights and shadows.
en: Turns on dynamic lights and shadows.

keys: Type the new password you want to use from now on.
en: Type the new password you want to use from now on.
zh: 输入你以后要使用的新密码。

keys: Type your current password so we know it is really you.
en: Type your current password so we know it is really you.
zh: 输入当前密码以便确认是你本人。

keys: Type your new password again so it can be checked for typos.
en: Type your new password again so it can be checked for typos.
zh: 再次输入新密码以检查输入错误。

keys: Zooms the whole game view by one, two or three times.
en: Zooms the whole game view by one, two or three times.
zh: 将整个游戏视图放大一、二或三倍。

keys: Sure, I'll bring her the offering.
en: Sure, I'll bring her the offering.
zh: 好的，我会给她带去供品。

keys: You're currently playing the web version, which may run slower and isn't as stable as the downloadable versions.
en: You're currently playing the web version, which may run slower and isn't as stable as the downloadable versions.
zh: 你当前正在游玩网页版，可能运行较慢且不如下载版稳定。

keys: This version is mainly here to showcase the game.
en: This version is mainly here to showcase the game.
zh: 此版本主要用于展示游戏。

keys: For the best experience, we recommend using the native client found on our itch.io page (Available on Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android).
en: For the best experience, we recommend using the native client found on our itch.io page (Available on Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android).
zh: 为获得最佳体验，建议使用我们 itch.io 页面上的原生客户端（支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android）。

keys: This is an open-source MMORPG and still a work in progress. You're welcome to explore, test, and enjoy the current features.
en: This is an open-source MMORPG and still a work in progress. You're welcome to explore, test, and enjoy the current features.
zh: 这是一款开源 MMORPG，目前仍在开发中。欢迎探索、测试并享受当前功能。

keys: We're also always looking for contributors!
en: We're also always looking for contributors!

keys: If you'd like to get involved in development, design, writing, or testing, feel free to join our community.
en: If you'd like to get involved in development, design, writing, or testing, feel free to join our community.
zh: 如果你想参与开发、设计、写作或测试，欢迎加入我们的社区。

keys: Otherwise, have fun and thank you for playing!
en: Otherwise, have fun and thank you for playing!
zh: 否则，祝你游戏愉快，谢谢你的游玩！

keys: We regret to inform you that your character was killed in battle.
en: We regret to inform you that your character was killed in battle.
zh: 很遗憾地通知你，你的角色在战斗中被杀。

keys: You are not that alive anymore.
en: You are not that alive anymore.

keys: No, kids. Your character did not really die. It... err... went to a better place.
en: No, kids. Your character did not really die. It... err... went to a better place.
zh: 不，孩子。你的角色并没有真的死。它……呃……去了更好的地方。

keys: You've outlived your usefulness. Mommy now wants you to help with supper.
en: You've outlived your usefulness. Mommy now wants you to help with supper.
zh: 你已经没用了。妈妈现在要你来帮忙做晚饭。

keys: I guess this did not run too well.
en: I guess this did not run too well.

keys: You've expired and gone to meet your maker.
en: You've expired and gone to meet your maker.
zh: 你已经寿终正寝去见造物主了。

keys: Bereft of life, you rest in peace.
en: Bereft of life, you rest in peace.

keys: If you weren't so animated, you'd be pushing up the daisies.
en: If you weren't so animated, you'd be pushing up the daisies.
zh: 如果你不那么活蹦乱跳，你早就在坟头草上长了。

keys: Right now, you would just love to be resurrected.
en: Right now, you would just love to be resurrected.

keys: I guess you're not the One.
en: I guess you're not the One.

keys: Don't panic, you're just a bit dead.
en: Don't panic, you're just a bit dead.

keys: It's a bit late to start digging your grave, don't you think?
en: It's a bit late to start digging your grave, don't you think?
zh: 现在开始挖自己的坟墓是不是有点晚了？

keys: Do you want your possessions identified?
en: Do you want your possessions identified?

keys: Sadly, no trace of you was ever found...
en: Sadly, no trace of you was ever found...
zh: 可惜，从未找到过你的踪迹……

keys: Dying is easy. Living is harder.
en: Dying is easy. Living is harder.

keys: Looks like you got your head handed to you.
en: Looks like you got your head handed to you.

keys: You screwed up again, dump your body down the tubes and get you another one.
en: You screwed up again, dump your body down the tubes and get you another one.
zh: 你又搞砸了，把身体扔进管道换一个新的吧。

keys: You're not dead yet. You're just resting.
en: You're not dead yet. You're just resting.
zh: 你还没死，只是休息一下。
所有人第一次都会跌倒。

keys: Fate, it seems, is not without a sense of irony.
en: Fate, it seems, is not without a sense of irony.
zh: 命运似乎并非没有讽刺感。

keys: Some men just want to watch the world burn.
en: Some men just want to watch the world burn.
zh: 有些人只想看着世界燃烧。

keys: There will be no order, only chaos.
en: There will be no order, only chaos.

keys: There's no hope for us here, only death.
en: There's no hope for us here, only death.
zh: 我们在这里没有希望，只有死亡。

keys: Death is the road to awe.
en: Death is the road to awe.

keys: Today is a good day to die.
en: Today is a good day to die.

keys: Any last words? Oops, too late!
en: Any last words? Oops, too late!
zh: 有什么遗言吗？哎呀，太迟了！

keys: There is no glory in suffering.
en: There is no glory in suffering.
